cohort: Mothers aged 15-24 years who delivered an infant within the 2 years preceding the 2017 Indonesia Demographic Health Survey.
finding: Proper postnatal care was significantly correlated with exclusive breastfeeding practices among adolescent mothers aged 15-19 years.
cross-section timing: Data was analyzed from the 2017 Indonesia Demographic Health Survey, including mothers who delivered an infant within the 2 years preceding the survey and assessing EBF in infants under 6 months of age.
